description: ADO-CURSOR paging and MaxRecords on SELECT ID, S FROM T ORDER BY ID: a client static read-only Recordset reads PageSize, PageCount, AbsolutePage and RecordCount, then PageSize = 3 (PageCount), AbsolutePage = 2, 3, 99, -1 and 0 (current ID, AbsolutePosition, BOF, EOF after each), PageSize 0, -1 and 100 (read back, PageCount); then Recordsets with MaxRecords = 4, 0 and -1 set before Open on server keyset and client static: RecordCount, all rows, MaxRecords read back. Asks the paging model and whether MaxRecords limits the rows each cursor returns.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
